meta.title: Renew a loan online
meta.fullTitle: Renew a loan online (members at home, staff at the desk)
meta.precedence: This document is the requirements baseline of LIB-101. Where the lending policy describes renewals differently, this document wins.

sections.title: Document control
sections.body:
**Status of a criterion.** Every acceptance criterion (AC) has one status:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Draft | Not decided yet. |
| Not yet implemented | The product owner decided the behaviour. It is not built yet. |
| Implemented | The behaviour is built and was verified against the system on 2026-10-16. |
| Known limitation | An accepted deviation. Section 8 describes it. |
| Non-binding target | Only for AC-11. It becomes binding once the open question Q-LOAN-02 is answered. |

**IDs.** `AC-` IDs and their sub-IDs (for example `AC-02a`), `RULE-LOAN-`, `EX-LOAN-`, `ASM-LOAN-` and `R-LOAN-` IDs are stable. Tests refer to them. Withdrawn IDs are listed in Appendix A2 and are never reused.

`KL-` IDs number the known limitations of this document. A parent AC keeps its full meaning, and its sub-ACs refine parts of it.

sections.title: 1. Description
sections.body:
Library members want to renew a loan themselves, at home, instead of coming to the desk. Today only a [[staff-member]] can renew a [[loan]].

LIB-101 adds the button "Renew" to the list of loans in the member account. A renewal moves the [[due-date]] to a later day if the library's rules allow it, and tells the [[member]] the reason if they do not. Staff get the same button at the desk, with two exceptions to the rules.

sections.title: 2. Scope
sections.body:
**In scope**
- Renewing one loan at a time, by a member or by a staff member.
- The rules that allow or refuse a renewal, and the message that names the reason.
- The confirmation email.

**Out of scope**
- Renewing several loans at once.
- Paying fees. A suspended [[member]] pays at the desk.
- Changing the [[loan-period]] of a [[title]].

sections.title: 3. Terms
sections.body: The terms are defined once, in the shared terms file, and linked from here. The list shows the terms this file relies on.

sections.title: 4. Roles and rights per action
sections.body:
| Action | Member (active) | Member (suspended) | Staff member |
|---|---|---|---|
| See own loans | yes | yes | yes, of any member |
| Renew a loan within all rules | yes | no | yes |
| Renew beyond the [[renewal-limit]] | no | no | yes |
| Renew an [[overdue-loan]] after the [[grace-period]] | no | no | yes |
| Renew a loan with a [[reservation]] by another member | no | no | no |

sections.title: 5. Reference data set
sections.body: All examples and test cases use these data. **Today is 2026-03-10.** Dates are in the library's time zone.
sections.after: The reservations and loans above are set up fresh for every test. A test only changes the data of the loan it renews.

sections.title: 6. Business rules and examples
sections.body: Each rule has at least one example. The examples use the reference data set.

sections.title: 7. Acceptance criteria
sections.body: The scenarios are written in Gherkin, so they can be copied into a test tool.

sections.title: 10. Acceptance risks
sections.body: Likelihood and impact are rated 1 (low) to 3 (high).

sections.title: 11. Traceability
sections.body: Generated from the stories and acceptance criteria.

sections.title: 12. Test cases
sections.body: The test cases cover the acceptance criteria. Each lists the rules and examples it uses.
sections.after:
### 12.1 Entry and exit criteria

**Entry**
- The build is deployed to the test environment, with the reference data set loaded.
- The email server of the test environment is reachable.

**Exit**
- Every test case of priority High has passed.
- No open defect of severity High.

stories.title: Renew a loan
stories.text: As a member, I want to renew a loan online, so that I can keep a copy a little longer without going to the library.

stories.title: Renew an overdue loan
stories.text: As a member who forgot a due date, I want to renew an overdue loan shortly after it, so that I do not have to rush to the library.

stories.title: Understand the outcome
stories.text: As a member, I want to be told why a renewal was refused and get a confirmation when it worked, so that I know what to do next.

stories.title: Renew for a member at the desk
stories.text: As a staff member, I want to renew a loan for a member who stands at the desk, even where the online rules would refuse it.

stories.title: Renew without waiting
stories.text: As a member, I want a renewal to answer quickly, so that I do not retry and renew twice.

ruleGroups.title: Overdue loans
ruleGroups.note: An overdue loan is renewed from today, not from the old due date.

rules.statement: A [[renewal]] of a loan that is not overdue sets the new [[due-date]] to the current due date plus the [[loan-period]] of the [[title]].
A [[loan]] can be renewed at most twice (the [[renewal-limit]]). The count is per loan, not per member.
A loan can't be renewed while another [[member]] has a [[reservation]] on its title. A member's own reservation doesn't count.
Only a member with the [[member-status]] `active` can renew a loan.
An [[overdue-loan]] can be renewed only within the [[grace-period]]: up to and including the 7th day after its due date.
The new due date of an overdue loan is today plus the loan period. The old due date is ignored.
A refused renewal names exactly one reason, the first that applies in this order: member status, reservation, renewal limit, grace period.
A successful renewal sends an email with the new due date to the member of the loan.
A [[staff-member]] can renew beyond the renewal limit and beyond the grace period. Member status and reservations still apply to them.
A renewal answers within 2 seconds for 95 % of requests.

examples.text: MEM-1 renews LN-1 on 2026-03-10. The novel is lent for 21 days, so the new due date is 2026-04-02 (2026-03-12 + 21 days), not 2026-03-31.
MEM-2 renews LN-8, a DVD that is lent for 7 days. The new due date is 2026-03-21, and the loan now has 2 renewals.
MEM-1 renews LN-2, which has 2 renewals. The renewal is refused with the reason "renewal limit".
MEM-1 has LN-2 at the limit and LN-1 without renewals. Renewing LN-1 is allowed: the limit is per loan.
MEM-1 renews LN-3. MEM-2 has a reservation (RV-1) on the atlas, so the renewal is refused with the reason "reservation".
MEM-1 renews LN-9. The only reservation on the poetry collection is MEM-1's own (RV-3), so the renewal is allowed. The new due date is 2026-04-02.
MEM-3, who is suspended, renews LN-6 online. The renewal is refused with the reason "member status".
MEM-2 renews LN-4, which is 4 days overdue. The renewal is allowed.
MEM-2 renews LN-7, which is overdue by exactly 7 days. The renewal is allowed: the 7th day still counts.
MEM-2 renews LN-5, which is 13 days overdue. The renewal is refused with the reason "grace period".
MEM-2 renews LN-4 (due 2026-03-06) on 2026-03-10. The new due date is 2026-03-31 (today + 21 days), not 2026-03-27.
MEM-2 renews LN-7 (due 2026-03-03) on 2026-03-10. The new due date is 2026-03-17 (today + 7 days).
MEM-3 renews LN-6. Three reasons apply: MEM-3 is suspended, MEM-1 has a reservation (RV-2) and LN-6 is at the limit. The message names only "member status".
MEM-1 renews LN-10, which is at the limit, and MEM-2 has a reservation (RV-1) on the atlas. The message names "reservation", not "renewal limit".
MEM-1 renews LN-1. An email to anna@example.org says that the new due date is 2026-04-02.
MEM-4 (staff) renews LN-2 for MEM-1. The loan is at the limit, but the renewal is allowed. The new due date is 2026-03-19 and the loan has 3 renewals.
MEM-4 (staff) renews LN-3. The reservation RV-1 still applies, so the renewal is refused with the reason "reservation".
MEM-4 (staff) renews LN-5, which is 13 days overdue. The renewal is allowed, and the new due date is 2026-03-31.
At the busiest hour of the day, 500 members renew a loan within one minute. At least 475 of the 500 renewals are answered within 2 seconds.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Renew a loan that is not overdue
scenarios:
Scenario Outline: A renewal moves the due date by the loan period
  Given today is 2026-03-10
  And <loan> has the due date <due date>
  When its member renews <loan>
  Then the due date of <loan> is <new due date>

  Examples:
    | loan | due date | new due date |
    | LN-1 | 2026-03-12 | 2026-04-02 |
    | LN-8 | 2026-03-14 | 2026-03-21 |

acceptanceCriteria.title: The renewal limit
scenarios:
Scenario: A loan at the renewal limit can't be renewed
  Given LN-2 has 2 renewals
  When MEM-1 renews LN-2
  Then the renewal is refused
  And the message says "You have renewed this loan twice already."
  And the due date of LN-2 is still 2026-03-12

acceptanceCriteria.title: The limit is per loan
acceptanceCriteria.statusNote: The member account counts all renewals of the member since the last release. This is being fixed.
scenarios:
Scenario: Another loan of the same member can still be renewed
  Given MEM-1 has LN-2 with 2 renewals and LN-1 with none
  When MEM-1 renews LN-1
  Then the renewal is allowed

acceptanceCriteria.title: A reservation by another member blocks the renewal
scenarios:
Scenario: Another member is waiting for the title
  Given MEM-2 has the reservation RV-1 on TI-3
  When MEM-1 renews LN-3
  Then the renewal is refused
  And the message says "Another member is waiting for this title."

Scenario: The member's own reservation does not block
  Given MEM-1 has the reservation RV-3 on TI-5
  When MEM-1 renews LN-9
  Then the renewal is allowed
  And the due date of LN-9 is 2026-04-02

acceptanceCriteria.title: A suspended member can't renew
scenarios:
Scenario: A suspended member renews online
  Given MEM-3 is suspended
  When MEM-3 renews LN-6
  Then the renewal is refused
  And the message says "Your account is suspended. Please visit the desk."

acceptanceCriteria.title: Renew an overdue loan within the grace period
scenarios:
Scenario Outline: The loan period counts from today
  Given today is 2026-03-10
  And <loan> is overdue by <days> days
  When MEM-2 renews <loan>
  Then the renewal is allowed
  And the due date of <loan> is <new due date>

  Examples:
    | loan | days | new due date |
    | LN-4 | 4 | 2026-03-31 |
    | LN-7 | 7 | 2026-03-17 |
acceptanceCriteria.notes: The second row is the boundary: the 7th day is still inside the grace period.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Refuse an overdue loan after the grace period
scenarios:
Scenario: Overdue by more than 7 days
  Given LN-5 is overdue by 13 days
  When MEM-2 renews LN-5
  Then the renewal is refused
  And the message says "This loan is too late to renew. Please return the copy."

acceptanceCriteria.title: One reason, in a fixed order
scenarios:
Scenario Outline: Several reasons apply
  Given <situation>
  When <member> renews <loan>
  Then the renewal is refused
  And the message names only the reason "<reason>"

  Examples:
    | situation | member | loan | reason |
    | MEM-3 is suspended, RV-2 exists and LN-6 is at the limit | MEM-3 | LN-6 | member status |
    | RV-1 exists and LN-10 is at the limit | MEM-1 | LN-10 | reservation |

acceptanceCriteria.title: Confirmation email
acceptanceCriteria.statusNote: The email template is not approved yet.
scenarios:
Scenario: Email after a successful renewal
  When MEM-1 renews LN-1
  Then an email goes to anna@example.org
  And it says that the new due date is 2026-04-02

acceptanceCriteria.title: Staff renew beyond the limit and the grace period
scenarios:
Scenario: Staff renew a loan at the limit
  Given LN-2 has 2 renewals
  When MEM-4 renews LN-2 for MEM-1
  Then the renewal is allowed
  And the due date of LN-2 is 2026-03-19

Scenario: Staff can't renew past a reservation
  Given MEM-2 has the reservation RV-1 on TI-3
  When MEM-4 renews LN-3 for MEM-1
  Then the renewal is refused with the reason "reservation"

Scenario: Staff renew an overdue loan after the grace period

  When MEM-4 renews LN-5 for MEM-2

acceptanceCriteria.title: Refusal reason in the mobile app
acceptanceCriteria.description: The mobile app shows the message "Renewal not possible" for every refusal, not the reason. KL-01 describes the behaviour. It is not a requirement.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Response time of a renewal
acceptanceCriteria.statusNote: It becomes binding once Q-LOAN-02 names the reference load.
acceptanceCriteria.description:
Measurement method:
- **Metric:** the time from the click on "Renew" to the answer in the browser.
- **Statistic:** the 95th percentile of all requests of a 10-minute run.
- **Environment:** the test environment with a copy of the production data.
- **Target:** at most 2 seconds.

testCases.title: Renew a plain loan and a short loan
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** A renewal moves the due date by the loan period of the title.

**Preconditions.** Today is 2026-03-10. MEM-1 is logged in and has LN-1. MEM-2 has LN-8.

**Steps**
1. As MEM-1, open "My loans" and click "Renew" on LN-1.
2. Log in as MEM-2 and click "Renew" on LN-8.

**Expected result**
- LN-1 is due 2026-04-02 and has 1 renewal.
- LN-8 is due 2026-03-21 and has 2 renewals.
- anna@example.org receives an email with 2026-04-02.
testCases.notes:
**Suite** A (renew). **Priority** High. **Automation candidate** Yes (e2e UI).

**Technique.** Boundary values of the loan period; use case testing.

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-01, RULE-LOAN-08, EX-LOAN-01, EX-LOAN-02, EX-LOAN-15.

testCases.title: The renewal limit is per loan
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** A loan at the limit is refused, and another loan of the same member is not.

**Preconditions.** MEM-1 is logged in and has LN-2 (2 renewals) and LN-1 (none).

**Steps**
1. Click "Renew" on LN-2.
2. Click "Renew" on LN-1.

**Expected result**
- Step 1 is refused with "You have renewed this loan twice already." The due date does not change.
- Step 2 succeeds.
testCases.notes:
**Suite** A (renew). **Priority** High. **Automation candidate** Yes (API).

**Technique.** Boundary value analysis of the renewal count (1, 2).

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-02, EX-LOAN-03, EX-LOAN-04.

testCases.title: Reservations and member status
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** Reservations of other members and suspended accounts block a renewal.

**Preconditions.** The reference data set is loaded. MEM-5 exists but has no loans.

**Steps**
1. As MEM-1, renew LN-3.
2. As MEM-1, renew LN-9.
3. As MEM-3, renew LN-6.

**Expected result**
- Step 1 is refused: "Another member is waiting for this title."
- Step 2 succeeds, due 2026-04-02.
- Step 3 is refused: "Your account is suspended. Please visit the desk."
testCases.notes:
**Suite** B (refusals). **Priority** High. **Automation candidate** Yes (API).

**Technique.** Decision table of member status and reservation.

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-03, RULE-LOAN-04, EX-LOAN-05, EX-LOAN-06, EX-LOAN-07.

testCases.title: Grace period boundary
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** The 7th day after the due date is still allowed, the 13th is not, and the loan period counts from today.

**Preconditions.** Today is 2026-03-10. MEM-2 is logged in.

**Steps**
1. Renew LN-7 (overdue by 7 days).
2. Renew LN-4 (overdue by 4 days).
3. Renew LN-5 (overdue by 13 days).

**Expected result**
- LN-7 is due 2026-03-17.
- LN-4 is due 2026-03-31.
- Step 3 is refused: "This loan is too late to renew. Please return the copy."
testCases.notes:
**Suite** B (refusals). **Priority** High. **Automation candidate** Yes (API).

**Technique.** Boundary value analysis (days overdue 4, 7, 13).

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-05, RULE-LOAN-06, EX-LOAN-08 to EX-LOAN-12.

testCases.title: Order of refusal reasons
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** If several reasons apply, only the first in the fixed order is shown.

**Preconditions.** The reference data set is loaded.

**Steps**
1. As MEM-3, renew LN-6.
2. As MEM-1, renew LN-10.

**Expected result**
- Step 1 names only "member status".
- Step 2 names only "reservation".
testCases.notes:
**Suite** B (refusals). **Priority** Medium. **Automation candidate** Yes (unit).

**Technique.** Decision table with precedence.

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-07, EX-LOAN-13, EX-LOAN-14.

testCases.title: Staff at the desk
testCases.steps:
**Objective.** A staff member can renew beyond the limit and the grace period, but not past a reservation.

**Preconditions.** MEM-4 is logged in as staff. MEM-5 (no email address) is a member at the desk without loans.

**Steps**
1. Renew LN-2 for MEM-1.
2. Renew LN-3 for MEM-1.
3. Renew LN-5 for MEM-2.

**Expected result**
- LN-2 is due 2026-03-19 and has 3 renewals.
- Step 2 is refused with "reservation".
- LN-5 is due 2026-03-31.
testCases.notes:
**Suite** C (staff). **Priority** Medium. **Automation candidate** Yes (e2e UI).

Blocked until Q-LOAN-01 is answered.

**Rules and examples.** RULE-LOAN-09, EX-LOAN-16, EX-LOAN-17, EX-LOAN-18.

limitations.title: The mobile app shows no refusal reason
limitations.text:
The mobile app of the library shows "Renewal not possible" for every refused renewal. The reason that the server returns is ignored.

The website shows the reasons as described in RULE-LOAN-07.
limitations.followUp: A follow-up ticket will be raised for the next release of the mobile app.

limitations.title: The confirmation email is in English only
limitations.text: The email of a successful renewal is always in English, whatever language the member chose for the website.

assumptions.text: A due date has no time of day. A loan that is due today is not overdue until tomorrow.
A reservation blocks renewals until the reserving member gets a copy or cancels it. Q-01 of the terms decided that a suspended member keeps theirs.

risks.text: A member keeps a copy that another member is waiting for, because the reservation check is skipped.
risks.testApproach: Automated API test with the reservation examples (TC-03)

risks.text: A wrong new due date because the old due date is used for an overdue loan.
risks.testApproach: Boundary values at 4, 7 and 13 days overdue (TC-04)

risks.text: Confirmation emails land in the spam folder, so members do not see their new due date.
risks.testApproach: Manual check of delivery to three common mail providers

questions.text: Does a renewal by a staff member count towards the renewal limit? (Same question as Q-02 in the terms.)
Which reference load makes AC-11 binding: the number of members, of renewals per minute, or both?
questions.blocks: AC-11 (stays a non-binding target until answered)

questions.text: Should the "Renew" button be hidden or disabled for a loan that can't be renewed?
questions.resolution: Disabled, with the reason as a tooltip. Decided on 2026-10-14.

decisions.text: The renewal limit is 2 per loan. The library board considered 3 and kept 2 to keep popular titles moving.
An overdue loan is renewed from today, and only up to the 7th day after the due date.
A member's own reservation does not block their renewal.

withdrawn.reason: Described a fee for late renewals. The library decided against fees.
